reels.title: M29 BANKA
reels.caption:
$5 a day. Where does it go? ☕

One makes coffee at home and drops a coin in the jar. One buys it every day. Day 30, an impulse buy. Next morning, coin in the jar again. A year later: $1,420 saved vs $1,825 on coffee.

Same coffee. Different year.

Send this to your coffee friend.

#money #saving #habits #discipline #motivation

reels.title: M30 PILLEKAN
reels.caption:
Same building. Two ways up. 🪜

One takes the stairs. One waits for the elevator. Day 30, out of breath. Next day, he climbs again. A year later: 36,500 stairs vs 12 hours of waiting.

Same stairs. Different year.

Send this to someone who skips the stairs.

#fitness #health #habits #discipline #motivation
